subject: System Design
title: Incident Response Process
description: A fast breakdown of Incident Response Process for builders.

hook.text: Production is down. Everyone is panicking, talking over each other, and trying different fixes simultaneously. Chaos.

buildup.text: Incident response assigns roles: commander (coordinates), communicator (updates stakeholders), and responders (fix).

discovery.text: The incident commander doesn't fix the problem — they coordinate. Keeping order during chaos is a full-time job.

twist.text: Communication matters as much as fixing. Stakeholders need updates every 15-30 minutes, even if nothing has changed.

climax.text: Structured incident response turns panicked chaos into coordinated recovery. Practice it before you need it.

punchline.text: Assign roles, communicate, coordinate — don't improvise during outages.

quiz.question: What is the incident commander's role?
options: Coordinating the response effort, not fixing the problem directly
Writing code to fix the issue
